title: DMU at 250 km/h
why: At exactly 250 km/h the 250 km/h pass-by limit applies; the DMU stationary row is 72.

noise.stationary_db.rationale: Noise TSI 4.2.1 Table 2 (LpAeq,T[unit]: electric locomotives 70, diesel locomotives 71, EMUs 65, DMUs 72, coaches 64, wagons 65 dB): DMU row, 73 > 72.

noise.pass_by_250_db.rationale: Noise TSI 4.2.3 Table 4 (80 km/h: electric locomotives 84, diesel 85, EMUs 80, DMUs 81, coaches 79, wagons 83 dB; 250 km/h, if applicable: electric locomotives 99, EMUs 95, DMUs 96 dB): design speed 250 ≥ 250, DMU row, 96 ≤ 96.
